capability: Run it three independent ways; trust agreement
title: Three runs, one gate.

hook.picture: Close on the whale between two pods. Each hands back a number card, and the two cards do not match. A reader pod turns rust ✕.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: Two tools gave me two answers. Which one do I trust?

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: three tries, each with one tool alone. A hidden slip rides the single line to the reader (2 beats). It repeats, faster each time.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: One tool alone hides its own slips.

stakes.body: A slip in one tool becomes a published result, and nobody can tell it apart from a correct one.

solution_hint: Build it three ways. Trust what all agree.

metaphor.body: Three whales build the same line three separate ways from one shared plan card, and the three lines must meet a gate at exactly the same height. Rust alarm.

steps.picture: Three lines in three tab colours (three languages) run out from one shared plan card, built by three separate whales.
steps.words: Build the same thing three separate ways.
steps.sound: Three voices, entering one by one

steps.picture: The three lines arrive at one gate. Their ends must sit at the same height. A ring measures them.
steps.words: Compare all three at one check.

steps.picture: Push-in: one line ends a hair lower. The gate shuts in rust and points at that line. It is fixed and rejoins the others.
All three meet exactly. The gate glows, labelled.

real_case.claim: On the 215-node FRONTIER sheaf, three independent libraries (Rust, Python, Haskell) gave identical results and matching per-edge discord; Agent Rails makes this three-way reproduction the test.

source.title: RESEARCH.md §3 (sheaf-memory gluing notes) and Agent Rails

honest_limit.picture: All three lines read from the same plan card, and the plan card carries a rust smudge. All three agree on the smudge. The gate glows green.
honest_limit.words: All three read the same wrong plan.

ending_pattern.body: The two mismatched cards of act 1 become three cards that slide into one, at one height, before the reader sees them.
ending_pattern.callback: Act 1's two cards at two heights become three cards meeting at one height.

end_belief.body: Check it more than one way.

score_self.reason: Two tools, two answers is an everyday research pain. The real run has a sourced number. The limit (a shared wrong plan) is the deepest honest point in the cluster and is drawn as a picture.
